name: postifys
description: Publish to Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest, LinkedIn, and TikTok from Cursor via the Postifys API: list connected accounts, upload media, publish, poll status, browse post history, retry failed posts, and manage the Content Queue.

POSTIFYS_API_KEY.title: Postifys API key
POSTIFYS_API_KEY.description: Secret. Create one in Postifys → Settings → API keys (starts with pfs_). Keep it private.
